pulls/589?checkpoint=privacyTerminal1130.body:
## Change

Cumulative HRM completion candidate retaining dormant reconciliation/roster work and the read-only partial schema exporter. This slice completes the remaining 4/9/33 route logging batches and seven HRM authorization-wrapper logs: 53 private caught-value sinks now emit fixed operation labels. Domain responses, typed 400/404/409/503 branches, bulk preview data, headers, security gates and return/await behavior remain unchanged. Three HRM Play Integrity bigint literals use equivalent BigInt constructors for ES2017.

Head `8053702bbde2a43da537e263630f8a81ded2b659`, tree `678503f2dc2a5a5d0c52d41156caee8bf100494b`, parent `ef5d90010d9b317a493dfe7ae574b1863f3c83fb`. Main `86cba428d39e3ce4be13245bdb8e34e49dccf8d4`; synthetic `e6beed0ed5f5960d427ace1678775f6473983d1e`. Delta: 36 production files and six new test/catalog/document paths. Support592 is unchanged.

## Current validation

- Owner: 2307 tests PASS, zero failures, 163 opt-in cases SKIPPED, across 265 test files. Includes 202 route cases, 35 auth-wrapper cases, 11 telemetry cases and three source guards. Targeted lint and whitespace pass.
- Independent local review: 248 handler/wrapper/telemetry cases, corrected scanner 3/3 and Play Integrity 5/5 pass; all 8762 parent blobs/modes and 42 final source bindings checked. Final document and 25 supporting hashes accepted.
- Expanded production typecheck remains exit2: 23 historical diagnostics versus 26 on parent; exactly three owned TS2737 removed, no new diagnostics. Test-inclusive scope adds two historical MTM fixture TS2737; foreign fixture, ES2017 target and baselines unchanged. No globally clean compiler claim.
- Initial test-fixture and source-guard failures are retained in evidence; final broad run passed.
- Exact-head remote review, mandatory hosted checks and sanitized restore receipt: **pending**. Prior-head green checks do not qualify this head.

## Canonical criteria and boundary audit

[Complete bounded inventory and consolidated matrix](https://github.com/rashadoni/leaddrive-v2/blob/8053702bbde2a43da537e263630f8a81ded2b659/docs/workforce-privacy-audit-2026-10-06.md).

WF-C10-011 remains PLANNED. The finite 46 routes plus seven HRM wrapper sinks are addressed; shared auth/RLS, Prisma/Pino/Sentry and destination/dashboard privacy remain open. A pure synthetic Sentry scrubber probe retained Workforce canaries; this is a source gap, not a production leak claim.

WF-C12-002 remains PARTIAL. Actual pull telemetry serialization to a synthetic sink covered nine result classes and 500 invalid label tuples. Principal/tenant/version cardinality, release-ledger aggregation, collector ingestion, paging/SLO approval and delivery are not established.

82/161 DONE, 79 open, weighted59%, 14/15 gates; C12-008 PARTIAL. No completion credit or denominator change. The finite logging batches are complete in this candidate; remaining acceptance dependencies are explicit in the matrix.

## Boundaries

No merge, deploy, activation, production collector, backup operation, migration/application, credential or permission change. No raw CI logs or screenshots inspected. Handler tests mock auth/schema/service/Prisma boundaries; skipped PostgreSQL cases are not executed database evidence.

Prior accepted request-logging evidence remains at [immutable archive](https://github.com/rashadoni/leaddrive-v2/tree/c3e196a14e56c16d038ff58fda036f9c9425e30e/docs/evidence/workforce-request-safe-logging-2026-10-06), preserving earlier source and restore attempt history.
